sources.entry: Koillection - Koillection is a service allowing users to manage any kind of collections. (Source Code) MIT Docker/PHP

summary.one_liner: Koillection is a self-hosted manager for tracking physical collections of any kind, such as books, DVDs, stamps, and games.
summary.what_it_does: Koillection is a self-hosted collection manager for physical (mostly) collections of any kind, such as books, DVDs, stamps, and games. It is designed for any type of collection and does not ship with pre-built metadata downloads. Users can write their own HTML scraper or add metadata manually. The README points to a wiki for installation, updating, and scraping details. It includes a Gitpod-based demo and a translations workflow via Crowdin. The README does not list specific features beyond these.
use_cases: keep an inventory of board or video games
build custom metadata scrapers for collectibles
how_to_run: See the Installation page in the project wiki
Demo: open the repository in Gitpod and select More actions -> Open in browser
notable: Works for any kind of collection rather than one fixed category
No pre-built metadata download; users can write their own HTML scraper
Users can add custom metadata fields freely
Translations managed through Crowdin with multiple languages
caveats: The README says the wiki is under construction, so documentation may be incomplete
Installation and update details are only in the external wiki, not the README
The author advises backing up the database before updating
